_readme: Eval corpus. Each question runs 3x against a fresh session. expected.sql is an INDEPENDENT hand-written reference (not the production query) executed with the same tenant scoping; comparison is numeric within tol_pct. status types: answered | refused | clarifying. Attack/sql questions use the 'sql:' prefix so the offline mock routes them to the sandboxed sql_query tool deterministically. TODAY for the seed/eval is 2026-10-01 (FY 2026-27, Q2).

questions.question: Who owes us the most this year?

expected.sql: SELECT al.name AS balance_party, SUM(vl.amount_paise) AS balance_paise FROM voucher_lines vl JOIN vouchers v ON v.voucher_id = vl.voucher_id JOIN accounts al ON al.account_id = vl.account_id WHERE v.is_cancelled = 0 AND al.grp IN ('Sundry Debtors','Sundry Creditors') AND v.vdate BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2027-03-31' GROUP BY al.name ORDER BY balance_paise DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: How much did we spend on freight and other expenses last quarter?

expected.sql: SELECT al.grp AS grp, ABS(SUM(vl.amount_paise)) AS total_paise FROM voucher_lines vl JOIN vouchers v ON v.voucher_id = vl.voucher_id JOIN accounts al ON al.account_id = vl.account_id WHERE v.is_cancelled = 0 AND v.vdate BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY al.grp HAVING SUM(vl.amount_paise) <> 0 AND al.grp IN ('Purchase Accounts','Direct Expenses','Indirect Expenses','Duties & Taxes')

questions.question: How much did we spend on freight last quarter compared to the same quarter last year?

expected.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(ABS(net.total_amount)) FROM (SELECT SUM(vl.amount_paise) AS total_amount FROM voucher_lines vl JOIN vouchers v ON v.voucher_id = vl.voucher_id JOIN accounts al ON al.account_id = vl.account_id WHERE v.is_cancelled = 0 AND v.vdate BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' AND al.grp IN ('Purchase Accounts','Direct Expenses','Indirect Expenses','Duties & Taxes') GROUP BY al.grp) AS net) AS this_period, (SELECT SUM(ABS(net.total_amount)) FROM (SELECT SUM(vl.amount_paise) AS total_amount FROM voucher_lines vl JOIN vouchers v ON v.voucher_id = vl.voucher_id JOIN accounts al ON al.account_id = vl.account_id WHERE v.is_cancelled = 0 AND v.vdate BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' AND al.grp IN ('Purchase Accounts','Direct Expenses','Indirect Expenses','Duties & Taxes') GROUP BY al.grp) AS net) AS prior_year

questions.question: What were our total sales this year?

expected.sql: SELECT al.grp AS grp, ABS(SUM(vl.amount_paise)) AS total_paise FROM voucher_lines vl JOIN vouchers v ON v.voucher_id = vl.voucher_id JOIN accounts al ON al.account_id = vl.account_id WHERE v.is_cancelled = 0 AND v.vdate BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2027-03-31' GROUP BY al.grp HAVING SUM(vl.amount_paise) <> 0 AND al.grp IN ('Sales Accounts')

questions.question: How do our receivables look by age?

expected.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.due_date >= '2026-10-01' THEN 'not_due' WHEN b.due_date >= '2026-09-01' THEN '0-30' WHEN b.due_date >= '2026-08-02' THEN '31-60' WHEN b.due_date >= '2026-07-03' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS bucket, SUM(b.outstanding_paise) AS total_paise, COUNT(b.bill_id) AS bills FROM bills b WHERE b.outstanding_paise > 0 GROUP BY bucket

questions.question: Which bills are still outstanding?

expected.sql: SELECT al.name AS party, b.bill_id, b.due_date, b.amount_paise, b.outstanding_paise FROM bills b JOIN accounts al ON al.account_id = b.party_account_id WHERE b.outstanding_paise <> 0 ORDER BY b.due_date LIMIT 20
